California sea lions in Columbia River forage for salmonids at Bonneville Dam

Vertical: UnknownHorizontal: Inferred yesOblique: Unknown
Evidence and details

Description: California sea lions in Columbia River forage for salmonids at Bonneville Dam

Horizontal: "There was strong support for models with social transmission of the dam-foraging behaviour compared with those without" (Schakner et al. 2016)

Domains: foraging

Anthropogenic effects: Sea lion predation on endangered salmonids jeopardized salmonid recovery and led to culling efforts. "Culling of sea lions preying on salmon at Bonneville Dam began in 2008, but was halted in 2011 during an injunction while being challenged in a lawsuit from the Humane Society of United States [16]. This highlights the challenges of culling charismatic predator species versus the threat of extinction of economically, culturally, and ecologically important salmon [17]." (Schakner et al. 2016)
